headerDisplay: The **Homebridge Air** plugin allows you to monitor air quality for your location from HomeKit and Siri.
footerDisplay:
Please raise any issues on our [project page](https://github.com/homebridge-plugins/homebridge-air/issues).

If you would like to have other features, please open a [feature request](https://github.com/homebridge-plugins/homebridge-air/issues/new/choose).

oneOf.title: AirNow
oneOf.description: AirNow is a U.S. government agency that provides air quality data for the United States.

oneOf.title: AQICN
oneOf.description: AQICN is a global air quality data provider.

configDeviceName.title: Device Name
configDeviceName.description: Name this accessory yourself. Leave empty to be named after the city you enter below, or after the station the provider reports on.

city.title: City
city.description: For AirNow: city name. For AQICN: city name, full AQICN URL, or full URL path like '/city/country/cityname', '/station/@stationid', or '/station/station-name/locale'. Explicit AQICN station/city paths are preferred over geo coordinates.

latitude.title: Latitude
latitude.description: Decimal degrees. Numbers or numeric strings are both accepted.

longitude.title: Longitude
longitude.description: Decimal degrees. Numbers or numeric strings are both accepted.

logging.description: Overrides the plugin logging level for this station only. None turns off all messages from this plugin. Standard shows normal activity, warnings and errors. Debug adds detailed messages, and is what to use when reporting a problem. Default behaves the same as Standard.

hide_device.title: Delete Device
hide_device.description: Delete this device from the plugin cache.

enableMatter.title: Enable Matter
enableMatter.description: Register Air Quality sensors as Matter accessories. Requires Matter to be enabled in Homebridge settings. Falls back to HAP if Matter is unavailable.

preferMatter.title: Prefer Matter
preferMatter.description: Prefer Matter over HAP when Matter is available and enabled in Homebridge. If Matter is unavailable, HAP is used as a fallback.

allowInvalidCharacters.title: Allow Invalid Characters
allowInvalidCharacters.description: Keep accessory names exactly as the provider reports them. Without this, characters HomeKit does not accept are stripped out and the change is reported in the log.

logging.title: Plugin Logging Level
logging.description: None turns off all messages from this plugin. Standard shows normal activity, warnings and errors. Debug adds detailed messages, and is what to use when reporting a problem. Default behaves the same as Standard.

items.helpvalue:
Refresh Rate
Refresh Rate indicates the number of seconds between polls of the AirNow or AQICN service.

Matter Support
Enable Matter support to register Air Quality sensors as Matter accessories. Requires Matter to be enabled in Homebridge settings (Homebridge v2.0+).
